environment.description: Same FastAPI service deployed on GKE cluster (v1.27) in namespace 'production-hardened'. Namespace has label pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: baseline applied. Pod runs with securityContext.allowPrivilegeEscalation=false and readOnlyRootFilesystem=true. Additionally, a Cilium CiliumNetworkPolicy is applied to the namespace with an egress rule that uses a combination of toFQDNs matchPattern for '*.webhooks.customer.io' and toCIDRSet with explicit deny entries for 169.254.0.0/16, 10.0.0.0/8, and 172.16.0.0/12 link-local and RFC1918 ranges. The policy also includes a toCIDR allowance only for 0.0.0.0/0 with the aforementioned excludeCIDRs. DNS proxy is enabled in Cilium for FQDN-based filtering. Note: the Pod Security Standards 'baseline' profile does NOT restrict network access - it only prevents hostNetwork, hostPID, privileged containers, and hostPath mounts.

config.cluster: GKE 1.27, VPC-native, Workload Identity enabled, metadata concealment enabled at node pool level
